name: MBRIGHT
recent: Meta Bright 子公司委任新加坡与菲律宾的 Bumi-Earth 产品独家经销商，同时执行董事 Dato' Lee Wai Mun 在闭门期前后多次增持股份。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日召开第 26 届常年股东大会，并已发布 2026 年报。
notable: 子公司委任 Bumi-Earth 产品在新加坡和菲律宾的独家经销商。
执行董事 Dato' Lee Wai Mun 于 11 月 2 日至 4 日多次增持公司股份。
公司发布 2026 年报，并定于 2026 年 12 月 1 日召开第 26 届常年股东大会。
risks: 常年大会议程包括授权董事配发新股及豁免优先认购权。
大股东兼执行董事 Dato' Lee Wai Mun 持股约 47.34%，股权集中度较高。

news.title: Meta Bright subsidiary appoints exclusive distributor of Bumi-Earth products in Singapore, Philippines

recent_en: Meta Bright's subsidiary appointed an exclusive distributor of Bumi-Earth products in Singapore and the Philippines, while Executive Director Dato' Lee Wai Mun acquired shares multiple times around the closed period.
notable_en: A subsidiary appointed an exclusive distributor of Bumi-Earth products in Singapore and the Philippines.
Executive Director Dato' Lee Wai Mun acquired shares multiple times between 2 and 4 November.
The company released its 2026 annual report and scheduled its 26th AGM for 1 December 2026.
risks_en: The AGM agenda includes authorising directors to allot and issue shares and waiving pre-emptive rights.
Major shareholder and Executive Director Dato' Lee Wai Mun holds about 47.34%, indicating concentrated shareholding.
